run_render_pipeline: run the hydra-configured render pipeline to render images from a 3D Gaussian model and save outputs
run_pca_feature_rendering: run the render pipeline with PCA feature visualization enabled to compute and save feature PCA images
run_gaussian_grouping_eval: run the render pipeline with GaussianGrouping model evaluation to visualize predicted object segmentation masks
run_uncertainty_mask_rendering: run the render pipeline with an Unc2DUnet model to generate and save uncertainty transparency masks
run_video_concatenation: run the render pipeline to concatenate ground truth and rendered images into a combined MP4 video
